channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: Dolphins claim to be undecided on Tua, but the verdict is already in
item.description: MIAMI — Tua Tagovailoa is neither a villain, nor a victim in this impending, expected breakup with the Miami Dolphins.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo says he is ‘committed to the Milwaukee Bucks’
item.description: Giannis Antetokounmpo is once again a committed Milwaukee Buck. For now.

item.title: Nearly 8 Months after a quadruple bypass, Ron Washington is back on the field with the Giants
item.description: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. — For anyone who has watched Ron Washington work with infielders, the sight was unusual, jarring even.

item.title: US men’s hockey rolls past Germany, closes Winter Olympics group play unbeaten
item.description: MILAN — With NHL stars back in the Winter Olympics for the first time in 12 years, organizers of the Milan-Cortina hockey tournament have seemingly done everything they can to make the players feel at home.

item.title: Anthony Edwards, youthful USA Stars prevail in new All-Star Game format
item.description: INGLEWOOD, Calif. — With youth on its side, USA Stars outlasted all challengers to come out on top during the new-look NBA All-Star Game on Sunday.

item.title: ‘Talk story with the Chief’ Tuesday in Waimea
item.description: The Hawaii Police Department is launching a new series of informal “Talk Story with the Chief” sessions aimed at strengthening communication and connection between police leadership and the community.

item.title: Questions over Lt. Gov. Sylvia Luke likely to inspire challengers
item.description: Democratic and nonpartisan elected officials across the state are quietly calculating the financial and political costs of challenging Lt. Gov. Sylvia Luke by the June 2 filing deadline while suspicions swirl whether Luke is the target of an ongoing investigation by Hawaii’s attorney general.

item.title: Initial ‘Green Fee’ projects are caught in funding dilemma
item.description: Gov. Josh Green is proposing to use debt instead of new special tax revenue to pay for an initial 18 “Green Fee” environmental improvement projects costing $42.2 million.

item.title: Back in the saddle: Cowboys basketball wins 4th DII state title in 6 years
item.description: KAILUA-KONA — The Koa Head Trophy is back in North Hawaii.
